summary.text: Zero-day options trading dominates retail activity as pattern day restrictions lift, generating extreme volatility in both directions with SPY and QQQ leading speculation.
Account destruction posts proliferate as international students and overleveraged traders share catastrophic losses, highlighting the psychological toll of speculative positioning.
Space sector catalysts and AI infrastructure spending drive conviction plays despite bubble concerns, with Tesla acquisition theories and OpenAI IPO filing sustaining momentum.
